description: This file defines build instructions for various firmware packages related to TI Wi-Fi and Bluetooth devices. It specifies how to install firmware binaries and create symlinks during the build process within the OpenWRT build system.

methods.description: Defines how to install firmware files for the wl12xx device, including copying binary files and creating a symbolic link.
